pullRequests.title: refactor(overlays): give byte pointers that are certainly mobys their Moby fields
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage3-measure
pullRequests.body:
A pointer converts only if its name, offsets and access sizes all fit Moby. Raw offset casts go from 6947 to 6667, and check_all passes with the same reports.
oclass_literals rises from 126 to 153 on purpose: those class numbers were hidden in raw offsets, and none has a name in the table.

pullRequests.title: refactor(overlays): give moby fields to files that lacked the Moby header
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage3-moby2
pullRequests.body:
Eleven files get the Moby header and fields. Raw offset casts go from 6667 to 6607, and check_all passes with the same reports.
oclass_literals rises from 153 to 175 on purpose: the class numbers were hidden in raw offsets, and none has a name in the table.

pullRequests.title: refactor(overlays): convert raw offsets to fields in bulk
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage3-bulk
pullRequests.body:
Raw offset casts fall from 6607 to 5965: a pointer converts only if its source or layout makes its type certain, with new shared PartBase and HitMessage headers and a pvars struct per function.
check_all passes with the same reports; 15 functions that changed stay raw, and fields with no known meaning stay unk_XX.

pullRequests.title: refactor(overlays): replace fake base addresses with the real globals
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage3-fake-bases
pullRequests.body:
hero_globals_base + 0xE1D is g_hero: 3339 of 4015 base-plus-constant sites now use the global the symbol table names there, and functions that need the old spelling keep it. check_all passes with the same reports.
extern_lines rises from 31497 to 31654 on purpose: a file with one base declaration now names each global it uses.

pullRequests.title: refactor(overlays): finish fake bases in fragments and give globals their real types
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage3-globals
pullRequests.body:
Real globals now reach the version fragments and the files the tool's bugs had skipped, and globals with one use become plain variables. A function that stops matching keeps its old spelling.
check_all passes with the same reports, and extern_lines ends at 31,667 (it rises because files name each global they use).

pullRequests.title: refactor(overlays): give small-data globals their real types with SDATA
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage3-enums
pullRequests.body:
extern short x read as *(float *)&x becomes extern float x SDATA(D_x) and plain x, so float_int_casts falls from 2408 to 723. check_all passes with the same reports, and src/game stays out because it changed .data.
address_names_in_code rises from 11687 to 13497 on purpose: each SDATA declaration has to name its address.

pullRequests.title: feat(data): write out zero blocks and pointer tables, and give data real types
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/data-tables
pullRequests.body:
104462 of 141334 data values are now plain C: all-zero blocks and tables of symbols, with no retail numbers committed. Float blocks and blocks with a shared struct type get real types, and their other values stay generated.
check_all passes with the same reports. LEGAL.md now says no numeric values, since tables hold symbol names.

pullRequests.title: feat(data): put all of .data in C and give blocks their local struct types
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/data-local-types
pullRequests.body:
All of .data is in C except 196 bytes (180 of them zero padding): a label not on 8 bytes joins the block before it, and the linker keeps it defined. No retail numbers are committed, and 18 more blocks get their real struct type.
check_all passes with the same code reports, and matched data rises from about 74% to near 98% of the data sections.

pullRequests.title: feat(data): put .lit, core rdata and level tables in C
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/data-rodata
pullRequests.body:
Data sections are now 99.955% in C: 315 of 699072 bytes are left in the blobs, 28 of them non-zero. No retail numbers are committed, and most blocks are still plain words.
check_all passes with the same code reports, and the data report now counts only bytes inside retail's sections.

pullRequests.title: style(repo): mark case fall-throughs and use one number base per switch
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/readable-switches
pullRequests.body:
63 cases that run into the next now say /* fall through */, and 29 switches use one number base. STYLE.md now says to keep empty cases, since removing them loses what the binary shows.
Comments and number style only: check_all passes with the same reports.

pullRequests.title: feat(data): give blocks the types the code reads them as, and add setup_compilers
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/fresh-clone
pullRequests.body:
219 data blocks now use the type the code already reads them as, and values stay generated. A fresh clone showed the README missed two compilers, so tools/setup_compilers.sh now fetches them.
check_all passes with the same reports, here and on a clean clone of main.

pullRequests.title: feat(data): split blocks at the addresses the code uses inside them
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/data-split
pullRequests.body:
pad_globals_base and others hid variables like g_controller_state with no label, so 373 addresses the code uses now start their own blocks and 84 of them take the code's type. Data in C stays at 99.95%.
check_all passes with the same code reports. build_sn.sh now rebuilds its list of undefined symbols each run, since data in C defines them.

pullRequests.title: refactor(data): readable names in SDATA, and move 465 blocks to the files that use them
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/github-readable
pullRequests.body:
SDATA now takes the readable name, which removes 2256 addresses, and Ghidra's references move 465 data blocks out of shared/data.c. Generated files are marked for GitHub, and 13 mass commits join the blame-ignore list.
check_all passes with the same reports. numbered_names rises by 1 on purpose: one name now also appears inside SDATA.

pullRequests.title: docs(repo): record what each fakematch does, measured by removing it
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/stage4-fakematch
pullRequests.body:
Each volatile and if (0) hack was removed once and compiled: all still change the code, so they stay, and 19 tags now say the exact effect. The other 13 tags already did.
Comments only: check_all passes with the same reports.

pullRequests.title: docs(repo): list the ISOs and dump commands in the README setup
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: docs/readme-dumps
pullRequests.body:
The README skipped the level and version dumps that setup_asm.sh and check_all.sh need.
Found by the fresh clone check.

pullRequests.title: refactor(game): give small-data globals their real types
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/game-gp-scalars
pullRequests.body:
84 more globals read as their real type; float casts go from 723 to 636.
The old src/game difference was a tool bug: a trailing comment hid the declaration.

pullRequests.title: refactor(hero): name the control modes the code proves
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/control-modes
pullRequests.body:
Adds enum HeroControlMode and uses it at 1,532 sites; 8 unclear values stay numbers.
Each name comes from the states HeroEnterMoveState pairs with that value.

pullRequests.title: refactor(audio): replace 50 local voice slot views with one shared type
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/voice-rows
pullRequests.body:
Row13E650, Voice, Snd and others were the same record, now VoicePoolRow with real field names.
f74, b74, on, playing and looping were all the slot's state byte.

pullRequests.title: refactor(hero): give local hero pointers their real type
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/hero-pointers
pullRequests.body:
117 char pointers become struct Hero pointers, removing 874 casts.
A pointer used any other way stays.

pullRequests.title: refactor(hero): read the hero directly, and merge HS and T_8 into shared records
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/hero-direct
pullRequests.body:
1,108 casts of g_hero's own address become g_hero.field.
HS is now CollisionHit and T_8 is HitMessage, in 14 files.

pullRequests.title: refactor(game): remove two if (0) hacks and three gp views with SDATA
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/fakematch-fixes
pullRequests.body:
Fakematch tags go from 31 to 29; two volatile casts become SDATA declarations.
The other sites each had one reasoned try, and it changed the code, so they stay.

pullRequests.title: docs(repo): write down the backlog after the refactor plan
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/fake-bases-2
pullRequests.body:
Lists what is left: fakematches, fake bases and unnamed control modes.
Adds the five new mass commits to the blame-ignore list.

pullRequests.title: refactor(overlays): replace fake base aliases and type more extern short globals
pullRequests.author: Lynder063
pullRequests.head: refactor/fake-aliases
pullRequests.body:
Local base aliases and version fragments now use real globals, and 83 extern short globals get real types.
Also drops 543 duplicate externs, taking extern_lines below where the refactor plan started.
